items.quote: We just sold off the coal mining company in Indonesia. The monies have been realized, and that's how you see the debt remaining under control.

items.statement: Expecting further generation of up to INR500 crores minimum from non-core land parcel sales at India Cements
items.quote: There are a couple of big land parcels, which we are discussing with potential buyers. I would expect further generation of up to INR500 crores minimum, which we should be able to get.

items.statement: Close to INR200-250 crores already realized from non-core asset sales at India Cements
items.value: Close to INR200 crores or INR250 crores
items.quote: Close to INR200 crores or INR250 crores. I'll give you exact number. That's a very easy number. If I can't give it on the call, you can reach out to, Ankit, later.

items.statement: Company is virtually debt-free on a net basis with net debt of INR0.1 crores, reflecting strong liquidity and cash flow
items.quote: Importantly, the company is now virtually debt-free on a net basis with a net debt of just INR0.1 crores.

items.statement: YTD free cash flow positive at INR 63 crores, up 9.4% year-on-year
items.quote: On a YTD basis, the business generated positive free cash flow of INR63 crores, which was also 9.4% up year -on-year.

name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd

items.statement: QIP of Rs. 1,250 crores executed in April 2025
items.quote: We also had a QIP of Rs. 1,250 crores earlier in April.

items.statement: Board approved appointment of Mr. Subrata Bhattacharya as Additional Director for 5 years subject to shareholder approval
items.quote: To further strengthen our Board, we are pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Subrata Bhattacharya as Additional Director for the term of 5 years, subject to the shareholder approval.

items.statement: Operating cash flow for nine months FY26 was Rs 439 crores before capex
items.quote: Yes, the operating cash flow is about Rs. 439 crores before CAPEX. So, that's the operating cash flow.

items.statement: Free cash flow generation of Rs 221 crores in nine months FY26 and cash and cash equivalents of Rs 733 crores as of 31st December 2025
items.quote: We continue to remain a net debt free company with strong free cash flow generation of Rs. 221 crores in 9 months FY'26 and a cash and cash equivalent of Rs. 733 crores on the books as of 31st December 2025.

items.statement: Working capital reflects planned inventory build-up for upcoming semaglutide launches, backed by customer advances or firm purchase orders, expected to normalize gradually over FY27.
items.quote: On the working capital trends, it reflects a planned inventory build-up for significant launches that are upcoming on the semaglutide launches. These are all temporary and timing-related, and we expect it to normalize over the course of time, gradually over FY '27.

items.statement: MD & CEO term extension of 2 years approved by Board, to be sent to RBI for approval
items.quote: Board has been insisting for a 3 -year term extension for me. And they are very comfortable. They were saying that I need to take it. So then I felt saying that because I need to balance the bank as well as my personal commitments also. So finally, I took a call for an extension of 2 years.

items.statement: CFO says pre-operating expenses for new ice cream and flavored milk plants are nominal and will be capitalized, not impacting P&L significantly.
items.quote: Ice cream, right now which is not there actually -- but it is not significant actually as far as ice cream is concerned because in the month of February and March, actually, we are going to commission. So, nominal actually then revenue expenditure has been taken into account to be charged within that, not very much.

items.statement: Working capital increased by 3 days to 14 days vs 11 days in FY25; receivable cycle slightly better
items.quote: Working capital marginally increased by 3 days as compared to 14 days as compared to FY '25 of 11 days. However, the receivable cycle has been slightly better.

items.statement: Management stated the company is currently debt-free and holds around INR 300 crores of cash.
items.quote: And as far as ROE is concerned, I think if you have to sce the cash adjusted equity, so that is much higher because we have around INR 300 crores of cash, which is lying with us and cash adjusted ROE is around 15

items.statement: ESOP provision completed; no further provision required
items.quote: It was the ESOP provision. So we have completed our -- we have granted the ESOP to the employees. And now it is not required to make the provision for the ESOP.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance was Rs. 1,626 crores at end of December.
items.quote: At the end of December, we had 1,626 crores of cash and bank balance which is very healthy.

items.statement: CFO states bank balance of INR630 crores as of date
items.quote: As of date, we have around INR630 crores in the bank. So we'll utilize that.

items.statement: Aseem Dhru steps down as MD & CEO, becomes Non-Executive Vice Chairman; Mahesh Dayani takes over as MD & CEO.
items.quote: It is a season of change at SBFC, where I hand over the baton to Mahesh Dayani. It is also a season of continuity as I move into the role as a Non-Executive Vice Chairman.

items.statement: Chief Collection Officer resigned; new officer joining by end of March, operational by first week of April.
items.quote: The new collection officer will be joining by the end of March, and in the first week of April, he should be there.

items.statement: Operating cash flow is healthy with minimal working capital needs
items.quote: We continue to generate healthy operating cash flow with minimal working capital need.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance around INR450 crores as of 31st December excluding dividend
items.quote: As on 31st December, we have around INR300 crores in form of reserve. And sorry, this amount, which I have told you, it is excluding the dividend, which we are offering. So, it comes to around INR450 crores as on 31st December.
